name: FSDD: Free Spoken Digit Dataset
description: Free Spoken Digit Dataset (FSDD) is an open audio benchmark comprising 3,000 recordings of English spoken digits (0 through 9) from 6 speakers (500 recordings per speaker). Styled as an acoustic equivalent of MNIST, it serves as a standard testbed for isolated word recognition and spectrogram-based feature extraction.
